articles.title: A Giant Icy World Hiding Beyond Pluto
articles.summary: Astronomers have spotted a possible sixth dwarf planet, 2026 ED138, hiding in a crowded patch of sky beyond Pluto.

articles.title: Did Dinosaurs Snack on Seaweed?
articles.summary: Chemical clues in fossil teeth suggest dinosaurs living near the coast ate food from the sea, including seaweed, 100 million years ago.

articles.title: The Video Game That Helps Teens Feel Better
articles.summary: Teens who played the game PlaySmart had fewer depression symptoms a full year later, a trial in 15 Connecticut high schools found.
